_about: S0-B3 auditor analysis (Claude Code, 2026-11-16) of every test call site at baseline 2240a8f, keyed by file:line. empty_pass_risk: none = assertions always run on non-empty data or a guard asserts non-emptiness; conditional = assertions sit inside loops/conditions without a non-emptiness guard, so the test could pass without asserting if inputs became empty (not observed); vacuous_observed = 0 assertions executed in the catalog run; core_vacuous_observed = the assertions that carry the test's intent executed 0 times, only incidental assertions ran. Evidence for observations: docs/audit/s0/b3/assertions.jsonl and probe_empty_pass.json.

tests/content.test.ts:18.checks: For every asset in public/content/registry.json: the file exists under public/, licence matches the allow-list regex, source is a Wikimedia Commons URL, statement is wikidata Q#P41/P94/P18, size > 100 bytes.
tests/content.test.ts:18.risk_note: No assertion that pack.assets is non-empty; observed 2510 assertions (502 assets x 5).
tests/content.test.ts:18.limitations: Checks registry metadata only, not the image content or the licence on the source page; the allow-list also accepts unversioned 'CC BY'.

tests/content.test.ts:28.checks: Every asset, entity text and character in the content pack references an entity id present in the database.

tests/content.test.ts:34.checks: Every non-portrait asset (flag/arms) has a recorded period that overlaps 1836–1936.
tests/content.test.ts:34.pass_condition: Overlap holds for every flag/arms asset.
tests/content.test.ts:34.risk_note: No non-empty guard; observed 275 assertions (176 flags + 99 arms).
tests/content.test.ts:34.limitations: The title says assets are 'never shown' outside their period; the test checks only the data overlap with the game span, not the UI date selection logic.

tests/content.test.ts:41.checks: For linked entities of kind people/region/period, every shipped non-portrait asset has quality 'supported'; plus asset ids are unique.
tests/content.test.ts:41.pass_condition: Inner expectations hold; shipped.size equals asset count.
tests/content.test.ts:41.risk_note: Observed 1 assertion (only the id-uniqueness check). The probe shows 68 targeted entities and 0 non-portrait assets shipped for them, so the quality check never ran. The property 'none shipped' holds, but the test cannot distinguish 'correctly rejected' from 'lookup returns nothing'.
tests/content.test.ts:41.limitations: Does not assert that the expected rejections are recorded (historical_data/assets/review.json).

tests/content.test.ts:50.checks: Every entity and character text carries a vi/en Wikipedia URL, revision id > 0, licence 'CC BY-SA 4.0' and > 40 characters.
tests/content.test.ts:50.pass_condition: All texts satisfy the fields; at least one text exists.
tests/content.test.ts:50.limitations: Checks attribution fields in data, not that the UI displays them (G-a requirement).

tests/content.test.ts:61.checks: Every linked polity's Wikidata 1836 lifetime check is 'ok' or 'not_applicable'.
tests/content.test.ts:61.limitations: Relies on the stored check result; does not re-query Wikidata.

tests/content.test.ts:65.checks: For strongly matched characters, DB birth/death years are within ±2 of Wikidata; a declared portrait is a shipped asset of that character.
tests/content.test.ts:65.risk_note: All assertions are inside conditions (match==='strong', both dates present); observed 460 assertions.

tests/data.test.ts:11.checks: Every source id cited under entities, wars and decision windows exists in db.sources.
tests/data.test.ts:11.limitations: Regions, benchmarks and other sections are not walked.

tests/data.test.ts:23.checks: Region population quality, entity population quality and law quality use one of the five labels.
tests/data.test.ts:23.risk_note: Iterates 662 regions and 274 entities; observed 1210 assertions.
tests/data.test.ts:23.limitations: Other quality-bearing fields are not checked.

tests/data.test.ts:28.checks: 'verified' population totals have at least one source; 'missing' populations name a fallback method; missing GDP per capita is flagged as fallback.
tests/data.test.ts:28.risk_note: Assertions are conditional on quality values; observed 328 assertions.
tests/data.test.ts:28.limitations: Method text matched by regex; does not verify the source supports the value.

tests/data.test.ts:37.checks: At least 145 playable entities; nine named small states exist; more than 90 decentralized entities.
tests/data.test.ts:37.limitations: Counts, not data quality per region.

tests/data.test.ts:44.checks: Region count equals map region count; every region's owner exists and the region has at least one map cell.
tests/data.test.ts:44.limitations: Does not check the 'exactly one owner' claim beyond the single owner field.

tests/data.test.ts:49.checks: Sum of region populations at start lies between 1.04 bn and 1.26 bn.
tests/data.test.ts:49.limitations: Bounds are the Maddison 1820 and 1850 totals, not an 1836 point estimate.

tests/data.test.ts:54.checks: Population method text of some entity mentions MEX, POR_home and SOUTH_ASIA; Mexico population quality is 'uncertain'.
tests/data.test.ts:54.limitations: Substring search in a free-text method field; does not check that both conflicting values are stored.

tests/data.test.ts:67.checks: Leaders of 13 named countries at the historical start are the 1 Jan 1836 office holders (name contains).

tests/data.test.ts:71.checks: Every starting leader took office ≤ 1836 and every heir born ≤ 1836; Francis II absent from Two Sicilies heir.
tests/data.test.ts:71.limitations: Year granularity; 1836 births after 1 Jan are allowed by '≤ 1836' except the named case.

tests/data.test.ts:79.checks: TEX_TEX owner MEX and controller TEX at start; the historical timeline says USA in 1846 but is not applied to state.

tests/data.test.ts:84.checks: Three named alliances active at start; three named wars active at start.
tests/data.test.ts:84.limitations: Does not assert absence of alliances/wars that were not active in 1836.

tests/modes.test.ts:13.checks: Both modes run every system and the same number of times (10 years, seed 7).
tests/modes.test.ts:13.limitations: Counts runs, not identical rules inside systems.

tests/modes.test.ts:18.checks: The historical mode config has exactly the expected toggle keys.
tests/modes.test.ts:18.limitations: Checks key names, not values or how they are used.

tests/modes.test.ts:22.checks: Five AI action types occur in both modes with ratio 0.5–2.

tests/modes.test.ts:30.checks: Historical bias and decision windows fire in Historical and never in Sandbox.

tests/modes.test.ts:42.checks: Mean final milestone similarity (3 seeds, 40 years) is higher in Historical than Sandbox.
tests/modes.test.ts:42.limitations: Three seeds; statistical claim without a margin.

tests/modes.test.ts:48.checks: Each Historical run misses at least one milestone.

tests/modes.test.ts:51.checks: GBR_open_china priority is inactive when Qing is protectionist and active when isolationist.
tests/modes.test.ts:51.inputs: createGame historical seed 4 with edited state

tests/modes.test.ts:69.checks: Region owners differ between some pair of seeds after 40 years.

tests/modes.test.ts:74.checks: Each sandbox run has > 5 war declarations, > 5 alliances, > 3 territory changes, > 5 law changes.

tests/modes.test.ts:82.checks: At least one non-historical territory change across sandbox runs.

tests/modes.test.ts:90.checks: Every alive country took at least one AI action in 8 years; five small countries took > 10 if alive.
tests/modes.test.ts:90.risk_note: Per-country checks conditional on alive; observed 6 assertions (all five alive).
tests/modes.test.ts:90.limitations: Counts actions, not quality of decisions.

tests/modes.test.ts:99.checks: A scripted Prussian war on Bavaria is logged and changes some region owner/pop vs the AI-only run.

tests/modes.test.ts:106.checks: In observer mode (no player) a set_tax command is rejected.

tests/modes.test.ts:114.checks: Victoria leads GBR by Aug 1837 and Hanover has no overlord.

tests/modes.test.ts:120.checks: No GBR succession log entry in Sandbox is the recorded 1837-06-01 Victoria succession.
tests/modes.test.ts:120.risk_note: Assertions only run per GBR succession entry; observed 1 assertion (one succession). With no succession the test would pass without asserting.

tests/modes.test.ts:128.checks: Territorial similarity is 1.0 at start in both modes.

tests/simulation.test.ts:10.checks: After 40 years: every region pop finite > 0, standard of living in [0,1], output finite; every alive country GDP/treasury finite and legitimacy ≥ 0.
tests/simulation.test.ts:10.limitations: Final state only, not intermediate months.

tests/simulation.test.ts:14.limitations: Plausibility band, not a historical benchmark.

tests/simulation.test.ts:21.checks: GBR, FRA, USA, RUS, SPA population after 40 years is within ×0.5–×2 of the 1875 CoW benchmark.
tests/simulation.test.ts:21.pass_condition: Ratios in range for countries that are alive and have a benchmark.
tests/simulation.test.ts:21.risk_note: A 'continue' skips countries that are dead or lack a 1875 benchmark, so the test could pass while checking fewer than 5 (or 0) countries. Observed 10 assertions per mode = all 5 checked at seed 1. F5: the title and comment say '1870 benchmarks' but the query uses date '1875' (simulation.test.ts:21-22).

tests/simulation.test.ts:34.checks: No country re-adopts, within 180 ticks, a law value it had left (flip-back).
tests/simulation.test.ts:34.pass_condition: No flip-back among same-group pairs closer than 180 ticks.
tests/simulation.test.ts:34.risk_note: 0 assertions executed. The AI never changes the same law group twice within 180 ticks (guard at src/engine/ai/ai.ts:119), so the pairs the test inspects never exist; the probe found 174 law changes and 0 same-group pairs within 180 ticks. The test cannot fail under the current engine and checks nothing at runtime.
tests/simulation.test.ts:34.limitations: Vacuous; the behaviour is enforced by code, not verified by the test.

tests/simulation.test.ts:43.checks: Every war still active at the end of the run is at most 145 ticks old.
tests/simulation.test.ts:43.pass_condition: st.tick - start ≤ 145 for wars in st.wars.
tests/simulation.test.ts:43.risk_note: 0 assertions executed: no war was active at the end (probe: 26 wars ended during the run, 0 active at tick 480). Ended wars are never inspected. The engine ends wars after 144 months (src/engine/systems/military.ts:128); the probe found the longest ended war lasted 145 months. The title says '12 years' while the bound is 145 ticks.

tests/simulation.test.ts:44.checks: Total AI research actions > 100 and construction actions > 1000 over 40 years.
tests/simulation.test.ts:44.limitations: Totals, not 'over the whole period' as the title says (no per-decade check).

tests/simulation.test.ts:51.checks: Sandbox seed 21: after 30 months, serialize/deserialize; both copies step 30 more months; serialized outputs are identical strings.
tests/simulation.test.ts:51.risk_note: Observed 1 assertion; string equality of the full save covers the whole GameState including RNG.
tests/simulation.test.ts:51.limitations: Only Sandbox, one seed, one split point (K=30, N=60), no commands, no Historical mode; no first-differing-path report. B4 (v3.2 §6.7) extends this.

tests/simulation.test.ts:57.checks: deserialize throws for a JSON object with a foreign format id.
tests/simulation.test.ts:57.limitations: Does not cover non-JSON input, unsupported version, missing fields (v3.2 §6.7 item 8).
